_comment: Confirmed driver/team Instagram handles, keyed by identifying features visible on the car (door number, livery text, sponsor branding). Injected into caption-batch.mjs's Gemini prompt so new photos of these same cars/drivers get auto-tagged. Only add an entry once Marc has confirmed the handle himself -- guessing a wrong handle tags a stranger.

drivers.name: Konstantyn Shchurenko
drivers.car: Toyota GT86, number 16, Trinity Racing livery

drivers.name: Jack Caldwell
drivers.car: Nissan Silvia S15, grey and blue, number 76

drivers.name: Jacob Krzyszczak
drivers.car: Nissan Silvia S15, number 720 -- CAUTION: a different, unidentified car (number 926, Thermotech/WrapHub branding) at this event also runs a purple/orange/black livery. DSC_4877-Enhanced-NR.jpg was wrongly captioned as Krzyszczak before Marc caught it via the raw source file. Always confirm the door number, not just the colour scheme.

drivers.name: Conor Falvey
drivers.car: Nissan Silvia S15, blue and white, number 412

drivers.name: James Deane
drivers.car: Three cars, all number 130: Nissan Silvia S15 (white/red/blue Worthouse livery), Ford Mustang RTR (blue RTR Vehicles livery), and BMW E92 (green/blue Falken livery, 'James Deane' text + Irish flag on the door) -- CAUTION: at the 130 Showdown event he only personally drove the Mustang and the Falken BMW E92 himself. Other drivers raced his Worthouse S15 and his ~5 other cars that weekend. Never caption him as driving/in the S15 at this event unless he is clearly visible behind the wheel (e.g. a cockpit shot showing his face) -- ownership-only phrasing ("James Deane's Worthouse S15") is correct for any S15 shot where the driver isn't confirmed. This exact overclaim was fixed 8 times across two 130 Showdown batches before this caution was added.

drivers.name: Conor Shanahan
drivers.car: Toyota GT86, number 79, Trinity Racing livery -- CAUTION: there is also a novelty oversized-driver miniature AE86 kart at this event (white/black, number 24, 'Oisin Corr' name and 'CORR Performance' text on the door, plate A386 COR, Ström Wheels branding), driven by Oisin Corr, unrelated to Conor Shanahan. Wrongly matched to Conor Shanahan in one caption before this note was added -- a GT86 and an AE86 are different cars, don't match on number or vague similarity alone.

drivers.name: Mad Mike Whiddett
drivers.car: Mazda RX-7, Red Bull livery, number 130

drivers.name: Chelsea DeNofa
drivers.car: RTR team driver, yellow/black Pennzoil race suit -- CAUTION: teammate Vaughn Gittin Jr. wears similar RTR/Pennzoil gear, Gemini misidentified this photo as Gittin Jr. before Marc corrected it. Don't ID either RTR driver from suit/sponsor branding alone, need a face or name badge match.

drivers.name: Adam Kelly
drivers.car: Nissan Silvia S15, number 54, Precision Graphics branding

drivers.name: Simen Olsen
drivers.car: Nissan Silvia S15, Grandal livery, black and yellow -- Gemini has described this car's colours inconsistently (yellow/grey, black/lime green, black/yellow across different photos), same car each time

drivers.name: Luke Tally
drivers.car: Toyota GT86, number 23, purple and silver, Exemplar Airport Concierge sponsor livery

drivers.name: Diarmuid O'Connell
drivers.car: Toyota AE86, purple, number 261, O'Connell Automotive branding -- @oconnellautomotive is his own sponsor/business tag, also visible on the car and separate from his personal handle. CAUTION: there is also a novelty oversized-driver miniature AE86 kart at this event (white/black, number 24, 'Oisin Corr' name and 'CORR Performance' text on the door, plate A386 COR, Ström Wheels branding), driven by Oisin Corr, unrelated to Diarmuid. Wrongly matched to Diarmuid in one caption before this note was added -- colour and chassis alone (both AE86s) aren't enough, check the actual livery text.

drivers.name: Adrienne Wheatley
drivers.car: Nissan Silvia S13, number 32, metallic red, 'A. WHEATLEY PRO' door badge, Candy Kulture Eire livery -- Gemini guessed the door's 'A.' as 'Alan' in one caption before Marc corrected it to Adrienne. Also CAUTION: a different red S13 exists in the same batch (DSC_4307) with a 'LUKE' tow-hook tag -- confirmed a different car/driver, don't assume every red S13 is Wheatley's.

sponsors.name: Ström Wheels
sponsors.identifying feature: 'STRÖM' or 'STRÖM WHEELS' text branding on wheels or bodywork -- Marc confirmed the handle 2026-09-23 after the verified account DMed him directly asking about their sponsored S15.
